description: Delete whole resources (frames, layers, sources, components). All or nothing: anything in use by something not removed in the same call is refused, with what uses it. (In a scene's draft; scene: its id.) Removing a resource needs its revision in `revisions` (path → the revision you read; "*": whatever is there, on purpose); without it the answer is REVISION_REQUIRED. It changes the draft only: viewers see nothing until publish_scene, and discard_scene_draft brings back what was published. Answers summary, removed (the paths) and draftRevision.

paths.description: The resources to delete, by path as get answers them: frame/intro, frame/intro/title (one layer), source/data/headlines, component/LowerThird

revisions.description: path → the revision you read it at (or its frame's; "*": whatever is there); nothing is removed if one changed since (CONFLICT). Over the MCP every path needs one (REVISION_REQUIRED)

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

name: scene_remove

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence
